description: Daily summaries written from all providers' views for a category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy makers), with the day's up/down tallies. Good for how a view changed day by day. Category keys (has_daily_digest) come from list_categories.

categories.description: Category keys, e.g. ["gold"] or ["top", "policy_makers"]. "__overall__" is the cross-asset summary.

limit.description: Digests per page, at most 100. Default 30.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 14 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: get_daily_digests
title: Get daily digest summaries
